description: Use this only after the user explicitly asks Johnson Bros. to call them about a plumbing need and provides their own contact details. This creates a callback lead, not an appointment, and can notify the office and send a transactional SMS acknowledgment. Do not use it for emergency dispatch; tell emergency users to call (617) 479-9911.

confirmed.description: True only after the user explicitly asks Johnson Bros. to contact them

email.description: Customer email, only when the customer offered it; never invent one.

issue_description.description: Short description of the plumbing issue

name.description: Customer full name, for example "Jane Smith"

phone.description: Customer phone number for the callback

urgency.description: How soon the customer needs the call: routine (default), soon or urgent. A callback is never emergency dispatch; life-safety situations go through emergency_help first.

name: request_callback
title: Request a Johnson Bros. Callback
